def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Treat full-color separator rows/columns as boundaries; repeat the one
    # non-background tile into every other tile of the same size.
    sep = 4
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    tiles = [(rbounds[i]+1, rbounds[i+1], cbounds[j]+1, cbounds[j+1])
             for i in range(len(rbounds)-1) for j in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    source = None
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in tiles:
        if any(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
            source = (r0, r1, c0, c1)
            break
    if source is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = source
    pattern = [grid[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0, sr1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in tiles:
        if (r1-r0, c1-c0) == (sr1-sr0, sc1-sc0):
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = pattern[dr][:]
    return out
PY
